shots.action: KTD touches a rain-streaked window, then walks through shallow floodwater toward camera with an amber flame reflected in the glass.
KTD crosses a narrow corridor with water rising around his steps while the camera dollies backward.
KTD holds a heavy metal door against the pressure of water and rain, breathing and refusing to release it.
KTD walks through a harsh white institutional room while blurred silhouettes block the route and fluorescent light pulses.
KTD marks a wet concrete wall with charcoal, taps the rhythm with his knuckles and begins to perform as dust and water move.
KTD enters a recording booth, reaches for the microphone and moves through hanging audio cables as rain vibrates on the glass.
KTD exits the booth into a flooded corridor; vapor and water advance while he keeps walking toward the amber light.
KTD power-walks through a rainy street carrying a small protected flame, with splashes and reflections moving on every step.
KTD climbs a wet platform inside a large warehouse while distant silhouettes rise in response behind him.
KTD crosses a technical studio, activates a patchbay and sends a wave of LEDs through the room while performing.
KTD places a ladder against a flooded wall and helps an anonymous young silhouette climb to safety.
On a rain-soaked rooftop KTD watches six distant lights activate across the city, then turns back to camera and walks.
KTD advances through a concrete tunnel in a continuous frontal dolly-back while lateral rain cuts across the frame.
KTD returns to the flooded street, touches the water surface and splits the amber reflection into expanding circles.
KTD opens a heavy metal door into an amber exterior, the door impact lands on the beat and he answers the lens directly.
KTD crosses a nearly empty wet room, slows, and places his forehead against rain-covered glass while breathing visibly.
Rain and tears mix on KTD's face; he lowers his eyes, closes them, then returns to a direct gaze as the light warms.
KTD crosses shallow water carrying a protected flame; droplets strike it and vapor rises as the camera arcs around him.
KTD performs in the foreground of a wet warehouse stage while shadowed figures advance behind and amber lights react to the hook.
KTD walks from a cold blue rooftop into an amber street through an organic match transition that preserves his step and shoulder motion.
The water settles; KTD opens his hand, the flame reflection disappears from the window and the final close holds on his heterochromatic eyes before black.
